name: Metaescaline
summary: Metaescaline (ME), also known as 3-ethoxy-4,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with an ethoxy group.

fact.en: Metaescaline moves escaline's ethoxy group from the middle of the ring to one side. Shulgin described both compounds in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: Metaescaline 把愛斯卡林的乙氧基從環的中間移到一側。舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述過這兩種化合物。
fact.zhHans: Metaescaline 把爱斯卡林的乙氧基从环的中间移到一侧。舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述过这两种化合物。
